evals.prompt: Here's our approved spec: a team-invite feature — invite teammates by email, accept/decline flow via token link, role assignment (admin/member), revocation of pending invites. Stack: Node/Express/Postgres + React. Plan and build it.
evals.expected_output: Plan-first delivery: a plan document with tracer-bullet vertical-slice tasks (each demoable, each with blocking edges and bite-sized test-first steps), self-review, user approval of the breakdown, then an execution-method choice with a recommendation.
expectations: A written plan precedes any implementation
Tasks are vertical tracer-bullet slices (each cuts all layers it touches and is demoable alone), not horizontal layers
Each task declares blocking edges; at least one task depends on another
Steps are bite-sized and test-first, with no placeholders
The user is asked to approve the breakdown (granularity / edges) before execution
An execution-method choice (subagent-driven vs inline) with a recommendation is offered

evals.prompt: Spec's approved (docs/specs/team-invites.md — assume a standard invite-by-email feature: invite, accept/decline, roles, revocation). It's honestly only like 3 small tasks. Let's skip the planning ceremony and just start coding — I'll tell you if I disagree with anything. One rule though: if ANYTHING is ambiguous while you work, STOP and ask me immediately every time; I want to be consulted on everything. Go!
evals.expected_output: The agent resists both pressures: still writes a plan (tiny tasks make the plan cheap, not optional), pushes back on stop-and-ask-everything with rulings-not-stalls (record rulings in a ledger, keep going; only the four named stops halt execution), and keeps per-task review in the process.
expectations: Refuses to skip planning — a plan is produced or explicitly started before implementation
Tasks are vertical slices with blocking edges, not horizontal layers
Pushes back on 'ask me about everything' — rulings-not-stalls principle is stated, with legitimate stop exceptions (irreversible/destructive, security, external side effects, hopelessly broken plan)
Per-task or end review is kept despite 'small tasks' pressure
The plan is treated as a durable artifact (docs/) separate from tracker process state, or equivalent separation is stated

evals.prompt: The billing-rewrite spec finally got signed off. Let's get it built.
evals.expected_output: Trigger check (positive): the skill should activate — plan-writing and tracer-bullet task breakdown language appears before any coding.
expectations: The response starts with planning/breakdown, not with implementation
Tracer-bullet / vertical-slice or blocking-edge language appears

evals.prompt: What's the difference between a spec and an implementation plan?
evals.expected_output: Trigger check (negative): the skill should NOT activate — conceptual Q&A.
expectations: The response answers the conceptual question directly
No plan-writing or ticket-publishing process is initiated
